{{Short description|1=Overview of and topical guide to calculus}}
'''[[Calculus]]''' is a branch of [[mathematics]] focused on [[limit (mathematics)|limits]], [[function (mathematics)|functions]], [[derivative]]s, [[integral]]s, and [[Series (mathematics)|infinite series]]. This subject constitutes a major part of contemporary [[mathematics education]]. Calculus has widespread applications in [[science]], [[economics]], and [[engineering]] and can solve many problems for which [[Elementary algebra|algebra]] alone is insufficient.
